summary.text: The grandmother of Saint Basil the Great, distinct from his sister Saint Macrina the Younger. Her grandson remembered her role in his Christian upbringing.
summary.reason: A concise source-bound account of the saint's life, identity and death; the linked modern source is not reproduced in full.

blocks.text: The GOARCH life of Saint Basil explicitly calls his grandmother Macrina a saint and distinguishes her from his elder sister of the same name.

blocks.text: In Letter 204, Saint Basil says that his grandmother raised him and handed on the teaching of Saint Gregory the Wonderworker. This is direct family testimony to her influence on his faith.
blocks.reason: A concise source-bound account of the saint's life, identity and death; the linked modern source is not reproduced in full.

blocks.text: Her remembrance concerns the transmission of Christian teaching within a family. Saint Basil appeals to what she taught him as evidence of continuity in his own doctrine.
